description: Python library and optional CLI for PyPI package download statistics from the pypistats API: daily, weekly, monthly and 180-day downloads, Python version and OS breakdowns and package metadata, with disk caching.
rules: Install with pip install pypi-package-stats and import from pypipackagestats; the CLI needs pip install "pypi-package-stats[cli]".
get_package_stats(name) returns a frozen PackageStats dataclass; call .to_dict() for JSON-ready output.
Results are cached on disk for 3600 seconds by default; pass no_cache=True or cache_ttl=0 to bypass the cache.
